name: implementation-plan
description: Define an incremental plan for the active task as IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md plus a TASK_STATE.md update: smallest safe slices with scope, validation and exit criteria. No code is written. A --spec mode derives slices from a spec or PRD. A retrofit mode annotates in-progress plans so they can adopt implement-fleet. Do not use when the task is too unclear, facts or decisions are open, or to implement an approved slice (use implement-approved-slice).
